title: AI agent for ecommerce: Shopify and email routines
h1: an ai agent for the shop work between orders
description: Three routines for Shopify order checks, customer reply drafts and product copy. Includes the extra connection setup and where human review belongs.
keywords: ai assistant for shopify store owners
answer: a store bot can read shopify orders and products, help you investigate customer emails and draft clearer product copy from the details you provide. start with a morning exception list and replies you review yourself. shopify needs your own composio project key and auth config; it has no composio-managed sign-in. once connected, keep store access read-only while you try these routines.
day_h: a store day with less searching

day.what: read yesterday's orders and list those whose fulfillment details need a closer look
match a customer question to the order number they gave, without assuming a similar name is the same person
draft copy from the existing product details and your notes, leaving missing dimensions or materials as questions
review unanswered customer threads and choose which draft replies are ready to send
look through recurring questions and decide which product descriptions need your attention

pack.name: the order exception list
pack.message: every morning at 9, read yesterday's shopify orders and their fulfillment details. list orders that appear to need attention, with the order number, recorded status and the reason you flagged them. separate missing data from an actual problem. report here only. don't cancel, refund, fulfill or edit orders.
pack.note: uses shopify order and fulfillment reads; [shopify connection details](/integrations/shopify) cover the extra setup

pack.name: the customer reply bench
pack.message: each weekday at 11, read new customer questions in my store gmail. where an email includes an order number, look up that exact shopify order. draft a reply in this chat using only the recorded details and my written store policy. ask me about uncertain matches. don't promise a delivery date, refund or replacement i haven't confirmed.
pack.note: both apps can stay read-only because the draft comes back in dusk bot; see [gmail](/integrations/gmail) for mailbox drafts

pack.name: the product copy check
pack.message: every thursday at 3, review the shopify products i named in this chat. compare their descriptions with the specification notes i attached. suggest clearer copy and list unanswered buyer questions. never invent performance claims, materials or customer reviews. give me proposed text here; don't publish or change any listing.
pack.note: name a small set of products first so the review has a clear boundary

sections.h: shopify takes an extra setup step
sections.md:
the connector catalog lists order, fulfillment, product and inventory reads, but shopify has no composio-managed sign-in. you need your own composio project key and auth config before the bot can use it. don't plan around a ready-made shopify sign-in.

you can start with email alone while that connection is being arranged. the [email triage routine](/use-cases/email-triage) is useful when the immediate problem is deciding which customer needs you next.

sections.h: a draft should separate records from promises
sections.md:
an order record is evidence of what the store recorded. it is not a promise that a parcel will arrive tomorrow. ask the bot to quote the status it found and name what still needs checking.

keep your refund and replacement policy in material the bot can read. if a request falls outside it, the useful result is a question for you. a calm draft that admits an unknown is better than a confident promise you cannot keep.

sections.h: keep money and publishing with you
sections.md:
allow only the reads needed for these jobs in **Connected apps**. that prevents the store bot from changing inventory or orders. if you later grant write actions, put "ask me before you change anything" in its routine; store changes are not documented as asking first automatically. sending email asks first unless you set a daily sending amount. one exception: a bot on **Full access** with no sending rule of its own may send up to 25 a day without asking, so give full-access bots **Ask every time** under sending.

running a shop is work use and needs a work license. see [pricing](/pricing), and remember that your ai provider bills ai usage separately.

faq.q: does this work for a non-technical store owner?
faq.a: you give the bot jobs in ordinary messages. shopify connection setup is the exception: its own composio project and auth config are required. begin with attached product notes and email if that setup is not ready.

faq.q: can it reply to customers without touching orders?
faq.a: yes. give it shopify read access and ask for drafts in the dusk bot chat. you can copy the reply yourself, or grant the specific email drafting actions if you want drafts saved in gmail.
these routines do not. they report what needs your decision. keep shopify read-only so the bot cannot make store changes.
